title: Logwolf: Remove a bunch of packet-specific menu items.
description:
Remove the following statistics and utility menu items and dialogs:

- 29West / lbmr
- ANCP
- BACnet / BACapp
- Credentials
- DCCP
- DNS
- Firewall rules
- HART-IP
- HPFEEDS
- HTTP
- HTTP2
- QUIC
- RSerPool
- SOME/IP
- Sametime
- Service response time
- TCP
- UDP
- UDP Multicast
